capabilities: Convert selected text between transliteration encodings
Trigger conversions from the command palette
Assign custom hotkeys to specific conversions
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed manually or via BRAT rather than through the standard community plugin listing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert Sanskrit text between transliteration encodings, so users must retype text or use external tools.

relations.evidence: Based on the SansConverter desktop app.

summary: Text-conversion utility that transliterates Sanskrit between IAST, Balaram, Harvard-Kyoto, Velthuis, and Ukrainian encodings via commands.
